reviews.title: Most ridiculous service ever - use an other airline when you can, even 1 star would be too much
reviews.text: They don’t have a lounge in LA, inflight entertainment in Business/First is not even basic. When you fly from West Coast to Hawaii you have lounge access but don’t expect food. Completely ridiculous. Food is only served in another lounge, accessible only for whatever premium members and East Coast travelers. Their customer service is even worse. It took me almost 4 months to get a copy of my electronic ticket, it was not automatically sent after the booking process. When you want to contact them via webpage they request a telephone number, but don’t even have Germany in the drop down menu to select country code. It took me more than 15 emails to get my ticket. No words for this outstanding non-performance. I selected them twice. The first and the last time
reviews.author: Detlev N

reviews.title: Don't fly with your dog
reviews.text: We booked our ticket to fly Hawaiian Airlines back in March, when we arrived at the airport in Big Island we were told that they changed their dog carry on policy in June, so that your dogs head can't touch the top of the carrier when sitting up. This is such a ridiculous policy especially as my dog is a 9lb Yorkie. I don't know how small of a dog would fit under the seat except for teacup sized dogs. I used the standard carrier size, which is already larger then needed for my dog, but because his head touched the top of the carrier he was denied access. Eventhough we booked our tickets before the policy and were not informed of the change, they didn't care. We asked for a refund on the spot and was told to call customer service. Customer service told us they couldn't give us a refund eventhough it was there fault and didn't inform us about the policy change. I ended calling the credit card company to help to try to get a refund and had to book another flight from the airport on Southwest Airlines. Lesson learnt. Never fly with Hawaiian airlines ever again. Just stick with Southwest if your in Hawaii. I told Southwest customer service about my issue and they just laughed and said how ridiculous it was for such a small dog to be restricted.
reviews.author: Zhen W

reviews.title: First Class Seat Upgrades Non-Existent
reviews.text: Now even a human cannot put me on a seat upgrade list. The phone app and the website have mysteriously removed any option to get an upgrade.
reviews.author: Johnny Osteen

reviews.title: Do not book Hawaiian Airlines thru Expedia
reviews.text: I booked my Hawaiian vacation to Hawaii thru Expedia and due to having part of my flight home booked with SunCountry we got totally screwed. Neither Hawaiian Airlines or Expedia would fix our flights when there was a delay with Hawaiian Airlines causing us to miss our connecting flights. Both blamed the other with being unable to fix the other flights.
reviews.author: Grace F

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I would like to provide a review of a very disappointing, unfortunate unsatisfactory experience that occurred on 5/6/2023. On Friday 5/5/2023 I arrived in San Diego such that I could take Hawaiian Airline directly from San Diego to Honolulu leaving at approximately 800 am and arriving at 1130 am. That Friday evening I received an email that my flight had been cancelled and they said subsequent rebooking information would follow. A new email was received with a new confirmation number and was told to check with the gate agent for final details. I arrived at the airport at approximately 540 am and the gate agent informed me that the flight had been cancelled and there was nothing set up yet for us to get to Honolulu. The gate agent and her supervisor who worked very diligently for over 2 hours came up with a plan that I could UBER to LAX and then fly leaving at 550 pm and arriving in Honolulu at 1030 PM. This arranged itinerary would be a 19 hour travel day that was intended to be a 6 hour direct flight. I would like to mention that an adjacent agent worked with another couple who arrived at the airport 45 minutes after me and was able to secure a flight from San Diego to Honolulu for that same day. As that couple walked away I asked why I didn’t get that flight and was given no response. On my UBER drive from San Diego to Los Angeles I found a Southwest Airlines flight that allowed me to leave LAX at 130 and arrive in Honolulu at 630. After booking this flight I called Hawaiian airlines to cancel the flight that had been arranged that morning which was very inconvenient and not timely nor did it meet mine or my wife’s needs. After being on the phone with an agent for 70 minutes of which the vast majority of the time I was on hold, a supervisor finally got on and informed me that the best they could do was a travel voucher. It has been almost 2 months and I have yet to receive a travel voucher, refund or get any information or communication on how this issue is being handled.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Destroyed my $300 "Indestructible" Luggage
reviews.text: This company absolutely destroyed my luggage. When I arrived in LAX I had a huge dent on my suit case and it was cracked. We arrived at midnight and the luggage claims area was closed. I didn't write a claim until the next day and by then it was apparently out of their 4 hour claim time and they denied my claim. This was after back and forth exchanges for months! I just found the whole experience BS. The flight was cramped, there's no leg room and we even updated. All to have my $300 luggage be destroyed by the airline. I even included photos. Don't fly with them if you don't have to, not worth the head ache or the money. Might as well have payed the extra money to fly Alaska, they give much better service.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Troubles on  Hawaiian Airlines
reviews.text: I'm rating Hawaiian 2 stars because of the problems with trying to check in. Good thing we arrived early at the LAX airport as the Hawaiian kiosks would not recognize my reservation, or that of most people that were trying to check-in. This made for long lines at the baggage counters. From Kona to Honolulu was better. But trying to check in for the flight from Honolulu back to LAX was crazy. I didn't see one person have success with the Hawaiian kiosks. As a backup they had only 2 agents working the counter to check people in. There was a group of 10 to 12 trying to check in for their flight to Sacramento. They only had a few minutes left and most likely missed their flight. The flights were mostly OK, but the food was poor.
reviews.author: Howard S

reviews.title: The worst company ever to buy a tickets
reviews.text: I purchased the flight in March, and I had to cancel the trip due to summer school and they did not give me my money back WHY THEY HAVE TO KEEP MY MONEY??? I did not cancel it at the last minute (my trip was going to be in July 24th). I had never had that issue with Southwest or / Frontier.... I also purchased an insurance just in case I had to cancel the trip and the insurance is a HUGE waste of money as well, you must be dying, super sick, had a very bad accident to be able to get your money back. And their Customer Service team are very rude as well.
reviews.author: KatiaS

reviews.title: Worst company ever
reviews.text: Check in: to leave the baggage you need to do 2 long queues. The first one is to check and pay the baggage and the second one to leave that one… which is the sense I don’t know and why they don’t do all in one really understandable Gate: we asked if can be possible to bring with us the car seat and ofc we know it’s not mandatory to approve or t or not. At the gate a nice lady with another colleague approved so we prepared all for that. Few minutes before to be open the gate another one came to us and we explained that they already check there is a seat where we can put our car seat. She left us and wasn’t happy ( just see her face) and after few minutes she came back and forced us to don’t go in the cabin and just put in the plane storage the seat car. Ok… why they didn’t say before? (Ofc the seat between me and my wife remain empty) Also we have a 5 months old baby and they ofc open the gate for all (handicap, military, vip, zone 1 and 2) and we were there waiting a lot Of time with the baby crying because they told us to go there but not for the paline but just wait ( another nonsense thing) On the conclusion the WORST service ever ( and I fly more the 12 times per month) The plane: nothing special but nice flight assistants but ofc the flight was in huge delay The first and last time with this company except if I will fly in Hawaii because this is the only company do these flights and maybe that’s the reason of worst service ever
reviews.author: Cognaman

reviews.title: Problem after problem after recent system upgrade
reviews.text: In the last 2 months they did a system upgrade and there have been issues across the board since. My sister came from LA to visit last month and wasn’t able to check in online or over the phone either segment, waiting in that line with 2 toddlers nearly sent her over the edge. My husband and I went from Kona to Honolulu for a night away and ended up spending 3+ hours of my trip on the phone with 4 different representatives trying to reinstate my ticket that had been mistakenly cancelled by the first representative. When you only have a few hours away to enjoy yourself and you spend it on hold it is very frustrating. I wrote them an email telling them what went wrong I got a that’s unfortunate response, nothing we can do to make it up to you. My husband and I have been a loyal Hawaiian Airlines customers. I have already started looking into using Southwest for future travel. The flights aren’t as frequent but substantially less expensive.
reviews.author: jenny

reviews.title: One of the worst flights I have ever taken
reviews.text: Flights were delayed at ever stop. The leg room was so bad when the person in front of me put their seat back it caught and trapped my knee keeping me from moving it. This triggered my claustrophobia. The food served was so disgusting, that passengers all over the flight refused to eat it. Just an all around bad experience.
reviews.author: Ken

reviews.title: 3 weeks of Hawaiian Air website “glitch “ I’m done forever!!
reviews.text: First of all I was planning to fly Hawaiian to Honolulu for August 2023 with my friends; for ten days. I went to their website directly as I meant to book a package flight- hotel to stay in Waikiki beach. Super excited to go with friends I haven’t seen in years and it’s my job to book and get reimbursed on the trip. I love Hawaii I go to either Maui or Oahu every summer for 30 years. This trip is for Waikiki and I get this email from Hawaiian Air about a month ago that I have 12,000 miles but I have to use them soon because they are going to “expire”. (Don’t get me started on expiring airline mileage - that’s the lamest thing ever!) Anyway, I go to book our trip 3 weeks ago and get all the way through hotel is selected, room and flight so last thing before paying is seat selection and then I waited… And waited…. And waited… Finally I’m like screw this I’ll do this later when I have more time! A few days to a week later I try again - Same issue!?? Watching the circle ⭕️ spinning and spinning and spinning with the message PLEASE STAND BY…. For 20 minutes!!! I take a shower- And still PLEASE STAND BY…. 20 more minutes still NOTHING!!! No message no email… A week later… SAME BLOODY PROBLEM!!!! I look at the Site Down page for Hawaiian “No problems to report in your area”!!! SAME THING EVERY TIME TODAY I try AGAIN- Same exact thing!! Both from my laptop and my phone SPINNING CIRCLES ⭕️……. Oh by the way incase you’re asking yourself did you try and book the flight separately from the package option- THE ANSWER IS YES I DID!! SAME FRIGGIN DEAL !!! …………….. You know what Hawaiian Airlines: KEEP YOUR 12,000 miles! I’m flying United or Alaska or ANY OTHER Airline but yours!!! AND 900.00 for each person by the time you have to upgrade at every single turn to get to bring a carry on bag onboard and get a decent flight out that isn’t 530 am or a red eye with 2 stops ????? I’ll frigging SWIM FIRST Profile DELETED!!
reviews.author: Mike M

reviews.title: Terrible Communication
reviews.text: We took a Hawaiian Airlines flight from HNL to JFK and sat on the plane at the gate in HNL for over two hours with the pilot only telling us the flight would be delayed another 30 minutes each time. During that time we had to listen to the advertising video and got a glass of water. If you want to fly an airline that treats its customers like they have no other options than fly Hawaiian.
reviews.author: Ron T

reviews.title: Worse ever pt. 2
reviews.text: Wrote a review about when we left for our vacation. Most horrible flight experience ever. Coming home after paying $$$$$ for first class only to find they totally damage my luggage. Material was completely ripped off one of the handles and someone tried to staple back on like I wouldn't notice. So while waiting for compensation for the ridiculous fiasco they put us through now I file a claim for the damage to my luggage. I finally receive an email from them and I have to provide photos of all kind stuff even though that was done at the airport as soon as i saw the damage. WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE IN ALL OF SERVICES!!!! I don't have the receipt for the luggage I bought over a year ago! Hawaiian totally f$&@$# us already just replace the damn bag!!! Btw their customer service email (which is the only way to reach them they won't take calls) has a 5k limit which is insufficient to explain this experience. Why can't we rate them 0 or negative stars. How are the heads of this company still employed?!!
reviews.author: Jared U

reviews.title: Late departure and crappy food
reviews.text: Check-in ....was fast and easy. Very polite and friendly staff at counter. Gate...Leaving from Gate 52 a long walk from the terminal entrance. Flight number HA452...Flight delayed for 1 hour due to late arrival of inbound HNL flight. Seats..Had seats 11J and 11K Extra comfort seats( extra charge) by them selves just behind Business class. These are great seats with plenty of leg room with a bulkhead wall in front of us which allowed us to move freely and not disturb each other. Food... was a snack chicken and tomato pesto wrap, an apple, small muffin and a drink. Not the best meal Ove ever had on a plane. Blanket was supplied no pillow. Entertainment was a pull-up screen and quite a few movies, tv shows etc. to watch for the 9hr 50min flight. Water and drinks available on request and water was offered by cabin crew every hour through the flight. Sleep quality was ok until 2hrs out of HNL when passengers started going to the bathroom and the doors kept on slamming really loud. We arrived in HNL 20 min late which was not an issue. bags were quick to be off loaded. Pro's... Fast check-in. Comfortable seats and aircraft. Friendly cabin and ground crew. Baggage quick to come off plane. Good selection of entertainment. Con's.. Food not that good. Noise level near galley and bathrooms was troublesome towards the end of the flight. Flight delayed but made up flight time for arrival into HNL. Mahalo
reviews.author: Wendy F

reviews.title: just no
reviews.text: My first flight with them was delayed by an hour causing me to miss my connecting flights. They needed to switch my connections. I waited over 2 hours for them and American Airlines to get it together. (AA is to blame for this too). It finally got done. But when I went back to get the receipts of my flights, all they can do is fund my original flight information. I need the ones from the flights I actually flew, not something that I didn't. Customer service said they can't do anything. I spoke to a supervisor. He also seemed very clueless. How does this company even work correctly? Their system is completely screwed up. YOUR company is the one who changed my connecting flight information. YOUR company should have my updates. NO. I demanded to speak to someone at the executive level. He told me that was not possible. How do they even function acting completely clueless like this???
reviews.author: Tiffany T

reviews.title: So bad and annoying
reviews.text: Both way from HNL - OGG sucks. Staffs were not nice (saying Mahalo but doesn’t sound like that.) My first time using this airline but 100% failed departing on time and couldn’t even find the gates when they arrived so we had to wait like another an hour. I don’t have any idea why do they have such a tight schedule and mess up freaking our plans. If you want to have fight on time maybe choose the first flight of the day.
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.title: They owe me almost $1,400 and refuse to communicate
reviews.text: After booking round trip flights for four people on Hawaiian Airlines (HA), HA cancelled the outgoing flight four days prior to the flight leaving. Since they had no similar flights available, I asked for a refund and was promised one. The agent who promised the refund issued me a refund on the tax only, approximately $45. She told me the balance, the actual ticket prices of approximately $1,400, would be refunded within 7-10 business days. It had been one month, and still no refund and I can not get HA to explain to me why even though I have called, emailed, chatted, and used their online complaint process. This is the worse customer service I have ever received and HA is in violation of Department of Transportation guidelines. The US Department of Transportation mandates that airlines must provide a refund for unused transportation, including non-refundable tickets, if the flight is cancelled or if there is a significant schedule change. They have seven business days to make a refund when a credit card was used, and I used a credit card. I strongly recommend using any other carrier when flying to Hawaii unless you want to lose your money.
reviews.author: Michael B

reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text: We did upgrade to extra comfort seats outbound and return flight. Outbound flight was excellent, on time and great service. Their food is awful!!! They offer "snack boxes " to purchase and only come down the aisle once to offer beverages, etc. Which is ridiculous for an over 6 hr flight!!! They will come back and offer a cup of water! Return flight was a nightmare! Was notified the morning of return flight changed....from 1:55pm to 5:15pm which meant getting home around 2:30am!!! We pulled away from the gate at 5:15..on time according to them and immediately stopped, then sat there for 15 minutes to then turn off the engines for another 15 minutes! I have multiple spine issues and was in severe pain from the extended flight delay, it took 45 minutes to get water to take a pain pill!! Totally unacceptable and disgusting! Avoid them !
reviews.author: GEM

reviews.title: N.A.
reviews.text: All services/food servings/cutlery are still in plastic and wrapped up in lot of plastic, which is a shame given environmental issues. There are environment-friendly alternatives and many other airlines have stopped using plastic years ago! Hawaiian airlines had only meals with meat - there were no other vegeterian or vegan options available at all! This lack of consideration/respect for diversity was shocking, not to mention the environmental impact of meat consumption - which is the number 1 cause of biodiversity loss. I encourage this airline to get up to date with planetary issues and show it through concrete actions.
reviews.author: Reema C

reviews.title: Good system with little waiting
reviews.text: We had good luck with Hawaiian airlines. We usually got through in 30-60 mins, They have a good system.. you go to a kiask, print your bag tags, tag your bag, drop your bags and then go on to security. We did run into issues with the kiosk but just tried multiple search criteria to find our flight and it usually worked out.
reviews.author: Kylee B

reviews.title: bad service
reviews.text: The trip has many annoying details that any other airline would avoid. 1. There was no communication at all before the departure (no email, no text, etc.). I could not check in online so I had to go to the airport at 4 am since they instruct on their website (yup, I had to find all the information on the internet by myself) to be there at least 3 hours early. Checking in using the kiosk is not available so I had to wait till their staff to come, which was one and a half hours later. Once again, there was no instruction at all that I had to ask around. 2. The whole flight was 18 hours including the short transit at Honolulu. But they provided snacks for the first trip, then one meal only for the second trip. 3. There was only one blanket for the second trip. I thought they would have at least one pillow so I did not bring one. When I asked for the pillow, the staff responded: "There is a blanket only" and walked away, even before I react. No sorry or anything. I guess you have to pay for the pillow. But the way she responded shocked me. The whole experience had many other annoying details as well. To be honest, this experience made me so uncomfortable to visit Hawaii in near future.
reviews.author: Quinn L

reviews.title: Absoutely terrible airline and would avoid!
reviews.text: I booked a flight from Maui to Honolulu and they cancelled the flight last minute. I received an email stating it was cancelled and called them directly to confirm. It happens and I get that. When I called in and they told me they would refund my money per the federal law established by the DOT. 10 days later I still hadn't received my money. I called backin they informed me that the flight wasn't actually cancelled and there was nothing they could do. They literally stole my money as I have an email confirmation that the flight was cancelled as well as a screen shot from the app stating it was cancelled. To top it off they made the news that evening for several cancelled flights because their internet went out. Despite that they refuse to refund my money and now I'm in a dispute with my credit card company and filed a complaint with the DOT. To all travellers I would avoid this airline line like the plague. I have never in my life experience a customer experience like this before. Avoid avoid avoid!!!!
reviews.author: JoeyFingerZ

reviews.title: Long lines, late departures
reviews.text: Was first in line to check in for my flight and had to wait over an hour due to them being behind on checking in people from other flights. The employees were fine they're just so understaffed. Plane also departed late both ways by about an hour.
reviews.author: David B

reviews.title: Bad service, old planes, delays, cancellations, and so on.
reviews.text: We flew Hawaiian Airlines the first time. Our flight was cancelled 1.5 hours before departure. We got a new one at the airport, after 2 hours wait. No apologize, no sorry. Second flight delayed, and delayed again, etc. Staff unfriendly. Worst airline experience so far, next to Air Canada. It is just another cheap, old carrier in the US.
reviews.author: Tobi B

reviews.title: Has Lost Its Stellar Experience
reviews.text: Very sad to see that this airline has now become just another average carrier with nothing special. No more full meal service (from mainland to the islands) other than an awful heated snack type item for lunch or dinner. No more complementary wine (I guess since no more full meal service). Cart service starts with food for pay, then followed by one free lunch/dinner type snack combined with beverage selection (soft drinks, water, coffee, etc.). That’s it. No second beverage cart service ( you can get a beverage at the mid plane or back of plane galley). So sad to see this. Baggage wait time was bad to horrible when arriving at destination (from recent trip to HNL and return to SMF).
reviews.author: Alan F.

reviews.title: Tile is lost
reviews.text: Sucks bad I would advise individuals to use American airline. Sad when we sat in the waiting area and they delayed our flight 2 times and we pay so much money to sit here eat and drink water. We have emergencys and important things in our lives. And they gave all the passengers is $10 food vouchers sad because that will get you chips ans a soda sad. And they should pay for our parking for our car for us waiting here we spent $250.00 😒 never again for this airline if u want to spend money in a airport come to Hawaiian airline sad and pathetic. That's all I have to say. Let's go American airline we should of got on your plane our family is worried and have to wait and spend more money waiting for us to appear in Vegas sad sad sad.
reviews.author: A W

reviews.title: Chaos and rude
reviews.text: First and hopefully last experience with Hawaiian airlines. Flights canceled and delayed. Evidently new computer cliches. agents were rude And not helpful. We sat on plane with door closed for over and hour waiting for luggage to be loaded. Thankfully we are flying back to mainland states from Maui and not on Hawaiian Airlines. Would not recommend flying this airline. But there are limited options flying from one island to another. Longest delay ever because you can't load luggage on a scheduled flight.
reviews.author: Brenda R

reviews.title: Worst experience ever!
reviews.text: As title suggests. THE WORST!!!!!! we show up 2 hours early only to be greeted with multiple different lines. There is no one but other passengers telling you where to go so maybe they and we should be paid for our services. So no employees guiding passengers to where they should be. Kiosks not working so we find the appropriate line to check our bags and an hour and a half later, bag checked through tsa to find our flight delayed. Okay stuff happens right. WRONG! We wait around for a few more hours. Yes hours! To get in line to customer service. Again chaos 1000 people where there should be a few hundred. there is absolutely no one helping 1000s of lost and confused people. Reach customer service and ask if we're okay because we have a connecting flight to the mainland. She tells us don't worry about it because all of hawaiian air is delayed so that flight not going anywhere. So we finally board our flight to oahu 8 or 9 hours after we got to airport. Reach oahu and our flight has gone and left. WTF!!!! Stand in another customer service line for another 3 hours to be rebooked on another flight and another 2 hours to retrieve our bags. This one is for the next night so we have basically lost 3 days of our 7 day vacation. We are hard working local people who needed a vacation and finally could afford one. Completely unacceptable! We are also not sure what the airline will reimburse us for. Total bs! It is now 230 am , 15 hours after we arrived to the maui airport and finally reached a hotel room.
reviews.author: Jared U

reviews.title: Dr.
reviews.text: This was my first time flying Hawaiin. On this day their computer system failed. 6 hours of MY life wasted at that filthy terminal. What terrible luck for both me and Hawaiin airlines. I will do EVERYTHING in my power to NEVER fly this carrier ever again. The cracks in their efficiency and management were already there I suppose. This catastrophe turned those cracks into chasms. On a plus, the patience shown by most of the gate attendants and staff was admirable.
reviews.author: Dreamer621611

reviews.title: Choose any other airline
reviews.text: Just wanted to go from Hilo to Honolulu. Entire Hawaiian Airlines computer system went down, all flights grounded. After 3 hours they get computer system back online and we board our plane. Probably 20 open seats on our flight. They will not let us take off until every seat filled. Okay, no biggie, American Airlines can fill standby passengers instantly. Not Hawaiian Airlines, it's taken 5 to 10 minutes per standby passenger. We've been sitting for 75 minutes while I wrote this review filling standby passengers one by one and we still have more seats to fill. At this point I will miss my next reservation which isn't Hawaiian Airlines so they don't care.
reviews.author: CJDREW

reviews.title: Vacation Hijackers
reviews.text: They will at all cost try to ruin your vacation! I would not trust any of my future travel with this airline. This is my 3rd flight that has been manipulated by them. They do not notify you- they trap you in a hot non climate controlled airport with very limited food. They aided people to sleep in horrible conditions. Equipment failure is the main reason they blame - but most important is Communication and care. They have stranded hundreds of people in 100 degree weather and do not even offer you water. They are fraudulent, dangerous and down right concerning! Please take my advice and never travel Hawaiin. Preserve your memories! @mamabear631 @kaitlyndjakov @hawaiinairlines
reviews.author: Kaitlyn Djakov

reviews.title: Suck
reviews.text: Been delayed two hours already. Then started boarding. Been sitting on the plane for an hour when the flight attendant announced we waiting on the pilots. If you want to lose your connecting flights and be delayed fly Hawaiian airlines.
reviews.author: Carel B

reviews.title: They cancelled my flight without asking me to cancel it and then blamed me
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight without asking me if that is what I wanted and then blamed me for the cancellation. they then told me I could rebook at the current fair which is 200 dollars more than I paid. I will be leaving a negative review every day until they fix this. I have flown Hawaiian many times. This is the worst customer experience I have ever received anywhere.
reviews.author: Andy W

reviews.title: Cancelled Flight With No Excuse or Apology
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight after we already paid for the rest of our vacation. They had no excuse for why the flight was cancelled. They had to put us on a different flight that didn't actually work for us and didn't offer us anything for our trouble. Use any other airline possible.
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text: It's quite amazing that this airlines is still in business. Their customer service is beyond horrific. My elderly parents were booked for a flight to San Diego from Honolulu on May 6 with aisle seats close to a bathroom for their convenience and medical condition. Hawaiian airlines canceled the flight at 6 am the day of the flight and told us via email to stand by for new flight information. After 6 hours of waiting for a new flight information, we attempted to call their customer service support. It took us 8 phone calls, 7 of which was disconnected and 4 hours on hold to get a representative that actually helped us get a flight on May 7. If we didn't spend all those hours on the phone, Hawaiian airlines would have never called with new flight information and my parents would still be stuck on the island. My parents suffered on the replacement flight that was given to them, they placed in the middle aisle and in middle seats away from bathrooms, my dad had a lot of discomfort trying to get in and out of the seats every time he needed to use the bathroom because he was in the middle seat in a row far from a bathroom. We planned ahead and reserved seats in the aisle and near a bathroom because of his condition. When Hawaiian airlines canceled the original flight, they didn't care at all to provide assistance for the replacement flight. This airlines should be ashamed to call themselves "Hawaiian", there's no Aloha on how conduct their business and have no respect for the elders. Their company motto should be "if we can't deliver what you paid for, you are on your own".
reviews.author: Allan M

reviews.title: Hawaiian Airlines flights to/from Hawaii and Mainland California cancelled.
reviews.text: Hawaiian Airlines flights to/from Hawaii and Mainland California cancelled. May 2023 Hawaiian Airlines cancelled several flights over the weekend to and from Hawaii - California due to an “aircraft shortage.” In other words, there were no planes available for the passengers. File a complaint with the Department of Transportation (DOT) www transportation gov / air consumer / file-consumer-complaint
reviews.author: Travel77Bug

reviews.title: Security called on my wife and I and infant son at delayed connecting flight in Maui airport OGG
reviews.text: The flight was a connecting flight to Seattle, WA from Honolulu HNL connecting in Maui OGG. The Maui to Seattle flight was delayed by over 4 hours and we were not informed or notified in any manner. We had arrived from Honolulu and were waiting by the gate when we noticed the departure time change. I was traveling with my wife and 9 month old son and we did not expect this and didn't know what to do since this was our first time travelling with him. My wife went to inquire about the situation and was told by the ,manager/chief at the gate desk and they said "there is nothing we can do". She was worried because we did not have any baby food left or formular and it was frustrating. I went to speak to the same manager/chief and ask if we could get any assistance because we would have to sit in an airport with an infant for an additional 4 hours on top of the initial 2 hour of our flight. While I was talking to them they called security and threatened to get us thrown out of the airport because manager said she will not speak to us because "we could not understand even is she tried to explain it" I believe she was trying to imply we were incapable of understanding her and we need to move out of the way so she can help other customers. Shas just gotten another frustrated customer who was yelling and screaming at her and being hysterical but she gave her a completely different treatment and gave her another flight since she was from there and decided to flight out another time. That other customer was white and we are Kenyan Americans. We stood back and record while the security arrived and started questioning us. This was so frightening for us. We didnt know what was going to happen to us. Were we going to get arrested? were they going to take out infant son from us? what were we going to do in a place that is foreign to us and we did not know anyone there so thats where we were recording for our own safety. We decided to wait it out because it felt like the more inquiries or help we requested it was met with aggression and complete disregard of out infant child. We swore never to travel there ever again because we have never felt so helpless and disregarded and treated so poorly compared to others. We also felt discriminated against on out departure flight from SEA, at out back check in line, the attendant ask who had to printed luggage tags, 2 couples of different race, from the safe flight as us and printed baggage tags for them an ask me to go print it myself at the machine and my wife who had our son in a baby carrier should leave the line and wait for me to print the luggage tag.
reviews.author: Rayburn M

reviews.title: Person
reviews.text: Horrible experience. Fly elsewhere. They changed our gate and never notified us. If I hadn’t waited toooo long in line, we would t have known and missed our flight. No notifications, no apologies. Then we waited in line again to get seats assignments??? After we waited and waited in line the ONE ticket agent told us she was concentrating on a different flight and we would have to wait and get in line again. Why?? We tried again to take care of everything online. Joined a lot of angry people in line to wait AGAIN. Run!!! The other way!!! I would recommend any other airline over this one.
reviews.author: Stacey M

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: This airline has certainly declined over the years. Had an inter-island flight booked to Kauai that I booked via United star alliance. Since I didn't book directly with Hawaiian Airlines, I had to check-in with an agent in order to get my boarding pass and I was also checking in luggage. Well, the inter-island agent line was waay long on a Sunday morning at 10:30am. It took about 30 min to get to the front of the line so I would allot a good 2 hours before your flight to come to the airport if you are checking in luggage. After the agent line you still have to wait at a baggage drop-off line where they recheck your ID. Luckily TSA precheck got us through security quickly with 35 min to spare to get to our gate. As soon as we arrived to our gate we found out our flight was canceled- only 30 min before takeoff! Who does that?! And so here we go again waiting on another agent assisted help desk line for 40 minutes just to rebook our canceled flight. Granted all of the agents are friendly and try their best but Hawaiian Airlines in general needs to clean up their act. Upon boarding our plane, there were dirty snack wrappers on the floor by my seat. I've flown this airline before and have never had any issues but in the future I don't ever want to go through this inefficient airline again.
reviews.author: Diana S.

reviews.title: Great Services
reviews.text: This was the first time we flew with Hawaiian Airlines. Unlike other airlines, flight attendants normally just watching passengers loading carry-on luggage to overhead bins while boarding. The crew from Hawaiian Airlines had at least one flight attendant to help passengers to load. This makes the boarding smooth and faster, since the flight attendants knew how to efficiently use the spaces in overhead bins.
reviews.author: flying2chiefs

reviews.title: Nightmare airport
reviews.text: Never have I had such a bad experience at an airport checkin and there have been some bad ones. Not only are the computers being “update” and so out of service but there was no staff helping the people in my line. They were trying to get out another flight but that is such poor management. I understand there is a flight to make but you should trickle in other reservations so that there isn’t a bottleneck and every flight is playing checkup. So dumb and most likely they will delay our flight by an hour if we are lucky because if not there will be a lot of people missing their flights.
reviews.author: Zoe O.

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever!!
reviews.text: We arrived at the airport to a text saying our flight was delayed 1 and 1/2 hrs ok no problem. While in TSA line another text now 4 hour delay. We had upgraded to first class 2 days before flight. Get to the gate and told delay was going to be 6 or more hours due to a part needed to fix plane not arriving on time. After 3 hours waiting received a call from the gate crew, they had booked us on an American flight direct to Lihue however only economy seats available. But assured me that Hawaiian would refund the 1200 dollar paid for upgrade not delivered. The following day Hawaiian did a system upgrade. Not only did they refuse to refund my money they lost my inter island flight even with confirmation number and ticket numbers after 2 hours on the phone I gave up and purchased another flight. I have flown all over the world many different airlines never have I encountered such horrible customer service!! I’ll never fly Hawaiian airlines again!!
reviews.author: Sheree A

reviews.title: The worst service in the skies!
reviews.text: The worst customer service of ANY business in America. We travel for business and pleasure a couple of times a month and can say without exaggeration, this company is the WORST with regards to service. We booked first class flights to Oahu a month ago. Days before our flight the airline called to say that my seat was broken and I was being moved. They separated our seats and put us in opposite corners of first class. When we called to have our seats put back together we wasted 3 hours with the “service” rep just to learn that they could do nothing and we would need to have the ticketing agent fix it…. We get to the airport and the ticketing agent says that she can’t fix it but the gate agent can… surprise, surprise, we get to the gate and the agent says there is nothing she can do. To make matters worse, the seat isn’t even broken!! It was all a LIE!! Not only did this airline completely screw up our overpriced first class seats, they wasted hours of our time, they repeatedly LIED to us and ultimately did absolutely ZERO to resolve our issue. The repeated lies are the most upsetting. If you can’t fix the issue just say so, offer us a drink for the screw up, take ownership of the mistake and we can all move on. This airline and every single customer facing employee have been consistently AWEFUL!! It’s as if they train their people to lie, to steal, to waste time and to do nothing for their customers. We have never seen anything like this before. Spend your money with Delta, United. American or Southwest. They won’t waste your time and lie to you.
reviews.author: Jason P

reviews.title: Worst airline I have ever used. Had to cancel my bookings...TWICE!
reviews.text: The flight for my first leg was cancelled 2 days before my trip. I had to rebook a new flight with them, only for it to be cancelled 2 days before my trip. I will never ever fly with Hawaiian Airlines again, and I suggest you don't either
reviews.author: Isaac W

reviews.title: Worst Airline in the industry
reviews.text: I have been flying for over 20 years and have never experienced the level of frustration I received from poor planning and poor performance of Hawaiian Airlines. We experienced delays and cancelled flights over multiple days. Now if I saw improvement in the results this would absolutely be a different review, but somehow Hawaiian Airlines managed to have the exact same issue on the exact same flights over multiple days! Being in operations where I work, if I see a problem once I try to make corrections. That fact that Hawaiian Airlines has the same exact problem 3 days in a row and doesn’t try to make any corrections just blows my mind. Good luck to you if you travel with Hawaiian Airlines
reviews.author: Joe P

reviews.title: Great flights, but
reviews.text: This actually applies to the fligh to LIH and return. At LAX, they have moved the gates to the far reaches of the Bradley West terminal, and it a mile walk from check-in to the gate and even longer from the gate to baggage claim. The club at LIH is a joke - a coffee machine and small bag of snacks - no other food, no restrooms in the club. I am used to American, Delta, KLM, etc. Baggage service is horrible at both airports. Large items (e.g. golf clubs) come off after ALL OTHER BAGGAGE and to a remote area even if you are "priority". On board staff were great and food OK, at least it was a hot meal. I will seriously look at going back to American for our next trip.
reviews.author: Ron C

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The HAL 7 flight on April 23 was full. What was worse is, that there were about 50 wheel chair people all doing prior boarding. Active military personnel did not get priority boarding. However when we landed 40 of this old farts had a spontaneous healing and could walk out of the plane, of course extremely slowly instead of waiting as they were asked to do. After that we had to wait on our baggage for an hour. After this experience I will never again fly with Hawaiin Airlines.
reviews.author: S Observer

reviews.title: HAWAIIAN AIRLINES IS AWESOME
reviews.text: We are currently in Kauai. Traveled via Hawaiian Airlines, even though we had to change planes in Honolulu, we had a great experience. We luckily missed the current issues that the airline has been experiencing, they updated their online reservation system and it basically crashed, we traveled the day right before 04/18/2023. Hopefully things will be back in order for our return trip at the end of the month. Everything went perfectly for us, check in was simple, got through the TSA line in less than 5 minutes, our flight actually left a little early. Once in the air, the first class breakfast was great, the flight attendants go out of their way to make sure you have everything you need. Although we are not looking forward to going home, we are glad that Hawaiian Airlines will be getting us there. Greg & Bella Fontana, CA
reviews.author: gregkw17

reviews.title: NO ALOHA AT ALL
reviews.text: HAWAIIAN MILES IS A SCAM! I am not one to really leave reviews unless service is either over the top exceptional or absolutely horrible. I have flown with HA hundreds of times. Both my husband and I live on Oahu and have been Pualani Platinum for years and have to say there are no perks to this. We are both Mastercard holders as well. We tried booking a flight this morning using my HA miles- I had 160,000 miles and saw that I could book a first class ticket using 80,000 miles. Common sense would say 80,000 x 2 = 160,000 but after selecting seats a "problem occurred while processing your booking" appeared. They refused to let me use my miles for both of us on the same reservation. I proceeded to book my flight separately then my husbands right after. The same exact flight booked no less than a minute a part is now worth over 120,000 miles. There was an option to use my remaining miles (80,000) and then purchase the additional miles which ended up being $900. SO DIRTY.... then wasted 45 minutes on the phone with customer service. We've been loyal customers for years and it's a shame that it means nothing.
reviews.author: keanibakula
